header.running_head: Keeping The Heart Free from Ill-Feelings and Jealousy

blocks.text: When the news reached Hadhrat Umar (RA) that Hadhrat Khaalid bin Waleed (RA) had Hadhrat Maalik (RA) executed and married his wife, Hadhrat Umar (RA) said to Hadhrat Abu Bakr (RA), "Khaalid has committed adultery so have him stoned to death." However, Hadhrat Abu Bakr (RA) said, "I cannot have him stoned because (he had not done so intentionally but) he had erred in his judgement." Hadhrat Umar (RA) insisted, "But you should have him executed because he had killed a Muslim." Hadhrat Abu Bakr (RA) again said, "I cannot have him executed because (he had not done so intentionally but) he had erred in his judgement." "Then at least relieve him of his post," demanded Hadhrat Umar (RA). Hadhrat Abu Bakr (RA) responded by saying, "I shall never sheath a sword that Rasulullaah ﷺ had drawn." [^1]
Hating the Sin and not the Sinner
Hadhrat Abu Dardaa (RA) and Hadhrat Abdullaah bin Mas'ood (RA) Forbid Swearing a Sinner

Hadhrat Abu Qilaaba narrates that Hadhrat Abu Dardaa (RA) once passed by a person whom people were insulting for committing a sin. Hadhrat Abu Dardaa (RA) said to them, "If you people ever found him lying in a well, would you take him out of it?" When they replied that they certainly would, Hadhrat Abu Dardaa (RA) said, "Then do not insult your brother but rather thank Allaah for safeguarding you (from the sin)." "Do you not hate him?" the people enquired. Hadhrat Abu Dardaa (RA) replied, "I only hate his evil act. When he forsakes it, he is again my brother." [^2]

Another narration states that Hadhrat Abdullaah bin Mas'ood (RA) said, "When you see your brother commit a sin, do not assist Shaytaan against him by saying, 'O Allaah! Humiliate him! O Allaah! Curse him!' Rather ask Allaah for safety (from the sin). We the companions of Rasulullaah ﷺ never said anything about a person until we knew in what condition he died. If he died in a good manner, we then knew for certain that he earned much good. On the other hand, if he died in a bad way, we feared for him." [^3]
